meta.title: Battle Beacon | Deploy. Dominate. Repeat.
meta.description: The definitive tactical command deck for Warhammer players and local gaming stores. Find games, run events, earn bragging rights.

hero.headline: Deploy.
hero.subheadline: Battle Beacon gives Warhammer players one command hub to find games, run events, and track every campaign. For venues, Beacon CRM fills tables, runs tournaments, and keeps your community mobilised.

pain.sectionHeading: The Chaos of the Old Way
pain.sectionSubheading: Players miss games, venues miss bookings, and disconnected tools make every event harder to run than it should be.

items.title: Fragmented Intel
items.description: WhatsApp chains and Discord threads get buried. Critical game postings, tournament slots, and store events disappear into the noise before you see them.

items.title: Paper Tracking
items.description: Manual score sheets create data loss and human error. Battle records vanish the moment the game ends. Your campaign history exists nowhere.

items.title: Ghost Venues
items.description: Store owners struggle to fill tables without real-time visibility into their local player base's schedule and intent. Seats go empty, events get cancelled.

items.title: Isolated Commanders
items.description: Without a centralised hub, finding regular opponents and consistent games across your local sector is a tactical nightmare.

solution.sectionSubheading: Deploying the Battle Beacon protocol. A unified operating system for the tabletop industry.

items.title: Unified Discovery & Booking
items.description: See local games, open tables, and venue events in one command hub so it is easier to get into the fight.

items.title: Battle Records & Achievements
items.description: Build a player profile with tracked results, rankings, awards, and badges. Earn an exclusive early adopter badge available only to the first wave.

items.title: Venue CRM & Automation
items.description: Beacon CRM gives stores one place to manage bookings, events, customer records, automations, and forms without juggling multiple tools.

cta.heading: Join Before Launch
cta.subheading: Sign up early to claim your place in the first wave of Battle Beacon players and venues, and unlock the early adopter badge before launch.
